Above and behind, smaller upper ranges SET BACK with actual glazed gallery arches, roof-garden terrace platforms, ornate star/rose parapets, relief cornices and small planters. The connected body has stepped levels and sublevel protrusions, not stacked disconnected boxes. Its lower frontage turns gently rather than remaining one flat straight line.
